0.speaker: Jesse
0.text: David, my son. Your brothers march with King Saul against the Philistines in the Valley of Elah.

1.speaker: Jesse
1.text: Take this grain and these loaves of bread to them, and bring back word of how they fare.

choices.text: What of the giant they speak of?

ask.speaker: Jesse
ask.text: Goliath of Gath. Forty days he has defied the armies of the living God. But do not fear him -- the battle belongs to the LORD.

yes.speaker: Jesse
yes.text: Go quickly, and may the LORD be with you. Cross the valley to the battle line.
